ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: MYEZ uses the camera to photograph the two products you want to compare. The photos are uploaded to MYEZ's servers and sent to OpenAI to identify the products.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: MYEZ opens your photo library only for the photos you pick. Those photos are uploaded to MYEZ's servers and sent to OpenAI to identify the products.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: MYEZ only uses the camera to photograph products. Audio is never recorded.
